title: Bernoulli and Shapley subset expectations
statement: Let $n$ be a natural number and let $f$ be a real-valued function on the subsets of $\{0,\ldots,n-1\}$. Integrating over $p\in[0,1]$ the expectation of $f(S)$ when each element is independently included in $S$ with probability $p$ gives the Shapley subset expectation: the expectation obtained by choosing a cardinality uniformly from $0$ through $n$, then choosing a subset of that cardinality uniformly.
hypotheses_covered: $f$ is a function from subsets of $\{0,\ldots,n-1\}$ to $\mathbb R$
